normalAboveRatingZeroSource: Model cards rate a network against the heuristic at 100 simulations with a fresh tree each move (rated 0). Normal plays the same heuristic but reuses its tree, about 40 Elo stronger (private research repo, research/2026-10-25-budget-vs-strength).
